mara (PM): Heads-up: onboarding customer BetaCo wants something lightweight that recommends batching/cache/quant per API route and can be trialed on their traffic. They want clear pilot success criteria before we enable any auto-apply. Can we draft minimal pilot gates?
dan (PM): We should ship an "advisor-lite" experience: read-only recs in the UI + an explicit 'apply to canary' button that creates a short-lived canary. No auto-apply in MVP.
ravi (Eng): Agreed. For recs we can provide: suggested batch_size, batching_window_ms, cache key type (prefix/body/hash), and a quantization flag with a recommended precision (int8/4bit) only for models we support. Each rec must include an estimated token-cost delta and expected latency delta.
joy (Data): For quality checks we'll run eval-triggered alerts: baseline metric per-route (customer-chosen; e.g., accuracy, ROUGE, likelihood) computed over a held-out prompt set. Recommend >=250 prompts for stable estimates. We'll compute effect size and bootstrap CI.
emma (SRE): Canary mechanics: policy = canary 5% traffic, monitor p50/p95 latency, error rate, GPU memory, and a quality metric hook from Data infra. Canary must run 12h with no SLO breach before rolling further. Also need an operator abort button + automatic rollback if queue depth or memory increase beyond thresholds.
mara (PM): Pilot success criteria proposal: 1) Advisor recs created for >=10 routes, 2) Customers run canary on at least 3 routes, 3) No customer-observed quality regressions > 2% on chosen metric during canary, 4) Average cost improvement >=10% on routes that accepted recs.
dan (PM): I want to add "observability" acceptance: per-route confidence band and sample output diffs surfaced in UI. Add a digest email for customers summarizing recs.
ravi (Eng): Tech caveats: realtime histograms needed (seq length distribution, model used, request shape). If customers have encrypted payloads we can't cache or compute strong fingerprints — must surface that as 'cannot recommend cache'. Also for quant recs we need an offline eval harness — that'll delay full quant support.
joy (Data): For gating thresholds I'm proposing conservative defaults: quality delta threshold = 2% relative drop; latency increase threshold = 10% relative. We surface both absolute and relative numbers. Confidence threshold = 80% bootstrap CI not crossing the threshold.
emma (SRE): Ops controls: tenant-level toggle to disable recs/auto-apply, a global kill-switch, and an audit log entry for every applied rec. Also require RBAC so only admin roles can trigger autopilot in future phases.
deploy-bot: Note: PROD-1789 created: "advisor-lite pilot backlog".
mara (PM): Owners and next steps: - Ravi: prototype batching heuristic + sample UI payloads (10d) - Joy: assemble eval sets for top 20 routes (2w) - Emma: define canary runbook + failure thresholds (1w) - Dan/Mara: customer pilot invite & KPIs doc (1w)
dan (PM): Prioritization: ship advisor-lite (batch+cache with read-only quant flags) in Q3. Add quant evaluation & one-click autopilot in Q4 after successful pilot.
ravi (Eng): One more detail: recs must include a short human-readable rationale (e.g., "75% of requests < 64 tokens => batch 8") and an estimated memory delta for quant suggestions.
joy (Data): We'll also log per-route sample mismatches when quant suggestions are flagged so customers can inspect failure modes.
emma (SRE): I'll add alerts for sudden traffic pattern changes during canary (spike in long seq requests) and a runbook step to pause canary automatically.
mara (PM): OK. If there's no objection I'll lock this scope and schedule a 30m kickoff tomorrow. Please add any major concerns now. :thumbsup:
